description: This file contains unit tests for the RecorderType's Writer and Reader classes, including test classes WriterClass and ReaderClass, and a test case 'test_writer' that exercises their functionality.

classes.name: WriterClass
classes.description: A test-specific subclass of RecorderType<uint32_t, BLOCKSIZE>::Writer, with methods to simulate writing data.

classes.name: ReaderClass
classes.description: A test-specific subclass of RecorderType<uint32_t, BLOCKSIZE>::Reader, with methods to simulate reading data.

methods.name: WriterJob
methods.description: Method in WriterClass that sets a buffer, creates a record, and calls various recording functions.

methods.name: ReaderJob
methods.description: Method in ReaderClass that performs reading operations, including time-stamping, stepping forward/backward, clearing data, and checking record IDs.
